title: 1st October - Youth Month Program - Elocution
summary: 1st October – Elocution Competition in English, Hindi & Marathi at Gamadia Girls High School (Junior and Senior Students), Princess Street.
description:
1st October – Elocution Competition in English, Hindi & Marathi at Gamadia Girls High School (Junior and Senior Students), Princess Street.
Day 4 of Youth Month brought together 153 enthusiastic students from 12 schools for an engaging Elocution Competition in three languages – English, Hindi and Marathi.
The young speakers displayed wonderful confidence, expression and clarity as they came forward to share their thoughts. It was heartening to see how thoughtfully the children prepared and how beautifully they expressed themselves, making the competition both meaningful and enjoyable.
As always, the day ended with a little gesture of care — bananas and fruit were distributed to all the participants.
A wonderful day of young voices, fresh ideas and the confidence to speak from the heart!
Beneficiaries 153 students
Project cost Rs 15,000/-
